extraction.Name: Anna W. Skenandore
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent in fee, but that it was mailed to her; that she accepted it with protest as she was told that if she did not accept it and keep the taxes up that the land would be sold to satisfy them
extraction.Recorded patent: Patent was recorded at Martin, South Dakota, some months later but does not remember date
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to R. C. Lessert Hardware Co. of Merriman, Nebraska, for the sum of $1649.50, the price of one Molene tractor; sold for $2500.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: for fear of losing her land, she sold it at the first opportunity before the date of the mortgage had expired
extraction.Occupation/Income: depends only on her husband's wages for their support; he is a first class carpenter and receives good pay
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent, in good health; owns no land, home, nor livestock; five minor children to support; sends four children to public school; high rent and high cost of living in cities make it hard to get ahead; has never received any help from the government, State or County, since she received her patent; was not defrauded of her land but realizes she was not competent at that time to come into possession of her deed; mortgage was for purchase of one Molene tractor in 1919; document sworn February 1929 before Notary Public, Milwaukee Co., Wis., commission expires May 6, 1929
